adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`'s `addGuestsMutation.onError`, the code builds `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;`. If `err.data` (or `err.data.code`) is absent, this will stringify to something like `"undefined: booking_not_found"` (or similar). Then `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")` will never hit the fallback because `message` is always a non-empty string, even when it contains `undefined`. Also `t(err.message)` will often just render the raw key if no translation exists, compounding the poor error output. This behavior is directly implied by the string interpolation in the diff.
